hypothesis: Fossil preservation is strongly biased against soft-bodied taxa.
pass_criterion: Taxa with no mineralised skeleton make up less than 5% of fossil genera in PBDB outside Lagerstatten, versus more than 30% of living marine genera, a ratio of at least 6 times.
fail_criterion: Fossil share of non-mineralised genera is at least half of the living share.
interpretation: The second sentence, about decay on non-depositing sea floor, is tested only indirectly through the taphonomy fields. Living proportions would have to come from a published estimate.

dataset.name: The Paleobiology Database
dataset.why_it_fits: Taxon and collection records carry composition and preservation fields.
